title: Scoped re-eval windows and ACLed golden views for regression debugging
creator: Noah Kim
description:
Problem: When model/config changes are deployed we often need to run targeted regression checks against a subset of our golden promptsets. Today re-evals require ad-hoc scripts, manual dataset copies, and coarse-grained ACLs which slows down root cause analysis and increases blast radius.

Goal: Ship a first-class capability that lets engineers and evaluators create timeboxed, queryable re-eval windows against golden datasets exposed as read-only 'views' that capture a snapshot of prompts, metadata, and model-config fingerprints. Each view should have temporal ACLs (grant access for N days), auditable provenance, and an orchestration hook to run only the impacted evals (by config diff) instead of full-corpus backfills.

Out of scope: Full provenance signing and immutable long-term archives (separate projects). This ticket focuses on UX, ACL semantics, and orchestration for short-lived re-evals (hours to weeks).
acceptance_criteria: PM & Eng agree on the scoped-view API: name, TTL, owner, reason, and linked config diff
Create read-only golden-view abstraction that points at snapshots without duplicating prompt payloads
Temporal ACLs implemented: grant/revoke window with email-based audit trail
Orchestrator accepts a view + config-diff and kicks off targeted eval jobs limited to changed prompt groups
Dashboard shows active re-eval windows, owner, TTL, linked PR/Config diff, and job status
End-to-end test: create view, grant 7-day access to evaluator, run targeted re-eval, observe regression alert if triggered
tasks: Design API schema for golden-view resource and TTL semantics
Design UI mocks for creating a re-eval window in Console (owner, reason, TTL, linked PR)
Implement backend read-only view mapping to existing golden dataset store
Add temporal ACL check middleware and audit logging (email + action + timestamp)
Extend eval orchestrator to accept config-diff and compute minimal prompt subset
Integrate Console dashboard tiles for active windows and re-eval runs
Write automated integration tests for ACL expiry and re-eval scoping
Document runbook and how to request emergency extensions for TTL
comments: 2025-01-28 - Noah Kim: Initial ticket created after follow-up with SRE about the slow re-eval turnaround. Proposed scoped-view concept during 1:1 with Ava.

2025-02-02 - Ava Martinez: Product review - we prefer 'views' over copies to save storage and reduce drift. Need clear semantics on immutability vs mutability of underlying goldens. Assigned to ENG for feasibility spike.

2025-02-05 - Priya Desai (ENG): Spike complete. Backend can implement a view pointer + generation id. We can compute minimal prompt subsets by matching promptset tags + config fingerprint diffs. Estimated 6 engineering sprints (parallel work possible).

2025-02-08 - Security review (Lauren Chen): Temporal ACLs acceptable if audit trail is stored in secure logs and TTL enforcement happens server-side. KMS signing deferred to separate ticket. Action: ensure audit exports to SIEM.
